verdict.rationale: The evidence shows `fly launch` detecting your existing project and generating a Dockerfile for popular frameworks, plus written blueprint guides such as remote MCP servers and Hermes. These are adjacent features that work on your own source code or walk you through manual setup. Nothing documents a gallery of one-click templates or starter projects for common use cases.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy one-click templates and starters for common use cases
